svg.title: An unknown-amplitude/diffusivity profile and 16 outer location projections; 16 are connected and 16 retain their generating location in this run.
svg.desc: The upper surface uses the predeclared first held-out truth, noise replicate zero, local-D design and zero delay; A is profiled in [0.7,1.3]. The dashed contour is the eight-dimensional noise-ball cutoff, not a one-degree-of-freedom likelihood-ratio contour. Values above 30 use the overflow color. D/M denote local-D/maximin; labels give delay and truth index. Solid bars are retained intervals; black circles/diamonds mark generating locations at delay 0/4. Here 16/16 outer projections are connected and 16/16 retain the generating location; 0 hit the resource cap. Width-stop unresolved boxes are retained. Model-based 95% coverage is pointwise, not simultaneous.
